# Enhanced.Testing.Component

> NuGet packages for component tests of ASP.NET Core applications: host the app in memory (WebApplicationFactory) with real PostgreSQL, Kafka and Redis containers (Testcontainers), EF Core, gRPC clients, WireMock fakes for external HTTP APIs and a fake TimeProvider. Targets .NET 8–11.

Each package ships XML documentation next to its assembly (`<NuGet packages folder>/<package id lowercase>/<version>/lib/<tfm>/<package id>.xml`); read it for exact API signatures instead of decompiling.

## Agent skill

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/skills/enhanced-testing-component/SKILL.md): how to set up and write component tests with this library, rules and package selection
- [Templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/skills/enhanced-testing-component/references/templates.md): fixtures for Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, WireMock, time and gRPC
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/skills/enhanced-testing-component/references/troubleshooting.md): error messages and fixes

## Packages

- [Enhanced.Testing.Component](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/src/Enhanced.Testing.Component/README.md): the component, HttpClientHarness, container options, customization
- [Enhanced.Testing.Component.PostgreSql](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/src/Enhanced.Testing.Component.PostgreSql/README.md): PostgreSQL container, template databases
- [Enhanced.Testing.Component.DbContext](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/src/Enhanced.Testing.Component.DbContext/README.md): EF Core schema and queries
- [Enhanced.Testing.Component.Kafka](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/src/Enhanced.Testing.Component.Kafka/README.md): Kafka/Redpanda, producer and consumer, waiting for messages, topics per test
- [Enhanced.Testing.Component.Redis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/src/Enhanced.Testing.Component.Redis/README.md): Redis/Redis Stack, data isolation
- [Enhanced.Testing.Component.GrpcClient](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/src/Enhanced.Testing.Component.GrpcClient/README.md): gRPC clients
- [Enhanced.Testing.Component.WireMock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/src/Enhanced.Testing.Component.WireMock/README.md): fakes for external HTTP APIs
- [Enhanced.Testing.Component.Time](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/duskembayev/Enhanced.Testing.Component/main/src/Enhanced.Testing.Component.Time/README.md): fake TimeProvider
